profile.headline: swe @ uber | data platform · distributed systems · python/spark/presto
profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Uber specializing in scalable data platforms, reliability engineering, and evaluation-grade data infrastructure. I engineered AI-powered OCR ingestion pipelines processing tens of thousands of images a week, using validation, dedup, and idempotent retries to make model output trustworthy enough to drive business metrics.
Previously, I interned at Uber twice — once on ML forecasting pipelines, once on storage infrastructure

My main interests include statistics, data-driven decisions, and distributed systems

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team: Data Platform, Mobility Trip Pricing, Marketplace

Worked on a scalable data platform which ingests, standardizes, transforms and monitors messy data
Integrated AI capabilities to the ingestion workflow with configurable OCR frameworks, parallel processing and alerting.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Apache Spark · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Data Pipelines · Hudi · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Big Data · Data Modeling · Systems Design · Cross-team Collaboration · Leadership

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern - Machine Learning
positions.description:
Team: Global Intelligence, Marketplace

Built ETL pipelines to construct training and eval dataset, from multiple upstream internal tables
Trained XGBoost and LSTM models to predict an internal business performance metric, performed feature engineering & evaluated model performances
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Hive · Apache Spark · XGBoost · Python (Programming Language) · Long Short-term Memory (LSTM)

positions.description:

Built a Java client which communicates with Internal Storage Platform Gateway via gRPC protocols and supports such endpoints as upload + download blobs, get metadata, and list entities
